news.headline: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (ankle, quad) listed as questionable
news.detail: Las Vegas Raiders tight end Brock Bowers (ankle/quad) is questionable for Sunday's divisional matchup against the Denver Broncos, coach Klint Kubiak said Friday.

news.headline: Questionable (Ankle)
news.detail: Bowers, who was limited at Thursday's practice, was back on the field Friday, but the tight end nonetheless will head into the weekend with a questionable designation. Look for added intel regarding his Week 11 status to arrive late Saturday or early Sunday via the usual assortment of NFL insiders,
